title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.

Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

title: Coordenador fiscal - Torre de faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.

Qualificações & requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;

Competências comportamentais:

  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;

Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

With a rich heritage of over 100 years, we continue to drive excellence in the chemical industry. We are looking for a qualified and dedicated professional to join our team.

The Business Development Manager (BDM) will be responsible for developing new business opportunities in the Tissue market in Brazil, according to the defined “Route Map.” This role requires close collaboration with commercial and technical teams to increase sales, improve product portfolio, and ensure compliance with Archroma’s sustainability policies and local legislation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new business opportunities in the Tissue market.
  • Collaborate with the commercial team to increase sales, volume, and gross profit.
  • Work with the technical team to develop new products and applications.
  • Identify new market opportunities and drive portfolio improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with legal requirements and Archroma’s sustainability policies.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Provide technical and commercial support to achieve growth targets.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify strategic opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Chemistry.

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder em monetização de conteúdo no Brasil, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com mentalidade de engenharia, foco em automação, observabilidade e resiliência — capaz de operar e evoluir ambientes críticos, distribuídos e de larga escala.

Responsabilidades

Administração, Observabilidade e Operação

  • Projetar e operar ambientes altamente disponíveis, escaláveis e resilientes em AWS e Azure .
  • Construir e manter SLOs, SLIs e SLAs , garantindo confiabilidade alinhada ao negócio.
  • Implementar práticas completas de observabilidade (métricas, logs, tracing, dashboards, alertas).
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e corrigir incidentes em tempo real.
  • Participar ativamente de on-call , garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz a incidentes críticos.

Automação, Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Criar automações de provisioning, deploy, monitoramento e testes (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD com rollback seguro e validações robustas.
  • Operar e gerenciar containers em Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS e AKS .
  • Implementar infraestrutura como código com Terraform , CloudFormation ou Pulumi.

Arquitetura, Resiliência e Segurança

  • Realizar tuning básico em bancos SQL e NoSQL, garantindo confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Configurar redes: DNS, rotas, firewalls, VPC, load balancing e componentes essenciais.
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança (IAM, RBAC, hardening e conformidade).
  • Conduzir testes de caos, cenários de falha, DR e resiliência.
  • Criar ferramentas internas que aumentem eficiência e reduzam débito operacional.

O que valorizamos

Mentalidade de engenharia e automação: eliminação de tarefas manuais e criação de soluções escaláveis.

Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados: decisões guiadas por evidências.

Colaboração multidisciplinar: integração com Engenharia, Segurança, Arquitetura e Produto.

Clareza na comunicação: essencial em ambientes críticos.

Autonomia, resiliência e priorização: atuação madura em cenários de pressão e alta complexidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida operando ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Domínio em AWS e Azure .
  • Experiência com Infra as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, AKS .
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  • Observabilidade: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace .
  • Conhecimento em redes (DNS, TCP/IP, VPC, firewalls, protocolos).
  • Noções sólidas de bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Scripts e automações (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Vivência com incidentes, RCA estruturado e práticas modernas de SRE.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica (fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce, telecom).
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS ou SNS.
  • Práticas avançadas de Zero Trust e segurança em nuvem.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas e event-driven.
  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure).
  • Participação em programas estruturados de on-call.
  • Contribuição para a comunidade (open source, artigos, palestras).

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Local: Presencial — Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte, liberdade técnica e foco em inovação.
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico (para CNPJs ativos há pelo menos 6 meses) ;
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível técnico, aprendizado contínuo e impacto direto no negócio.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos evoluindo e ampliando nossa infraestrutura para suportar o crescimento acelerado da plataforma.

Como SRE, você terá impacto direto na confiabilidade, segurança, escala e eficiência dos sistemas que atendem milhões de usuários.

Se você busca um ambiente técnico desafiador, com autonomia e cultura de engenharia madura, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Remote – Brazil

*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

Company Overview

Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.

Position Overview

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.

Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Além disso, será responsável por otimizar processos de movimentação interna, recebimento, armazenagem e expedição, buscando eficiência e redução de desperdícios, bem como estruturar uma cadeia de gestão ágil e eficaz.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD

We are seeking  a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.

What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and  disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD) and  Pair Programming as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with  Java/Spring Boot on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with  React on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing  Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.

Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP): Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning: Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization: Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  ARC system.
  • Allocations: Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown  KOALA system.

Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.

Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.
  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by our partner.
  • Ability to learn and comply with all company policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
  • Ability to give direction and to receive, understand, and proactively respond to direction from leadership and other company personnel.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and interact effectively and appropriately with others.
  • Ability to maintain composure and work in a fast-paced environment while accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes.
  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating and preparing reports.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and monitor activities across business units.
  • Ability to complete or oversee the completion of assigned projects in a timely manner.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

Role duration: 6 months with option to renew

Core hours: 9 am - 5 pm US Central Time Zone

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior (AWS)
description:

Na Eyna, transformamos imagens em decisões inteligentes. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em visão computacional e IA multimodal, integrando câmeras, sensores IoT e dados corporativos para tornar operações mais seguras, eficientes e previsíveis.

Estamos crescendo e buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Júnior, já formado(a) e com pelo menos 1 estágio em área correlata, para aprender rápido, crescer junto com o time e assumir missões cada vez mais críticas em um ambiente ágil, meritocrático e muito mão na massa.

  • Local: presencial
  • Remuneração: R$ 7k
  • Benefícios: Participação nos resultados, 20 dias úteis de time off, WellHub/GymPass
  • Modelo de Contratação: PJ
Sua missão
  • Desenvolver e evoluir módulos da nossa plataforma SaaS (back-end e front-end), conectando câmeras, sensores e sistemas corporativos.
  • Criar e manter APIs e integrações para que clientes consigam consumir nossos modelos de visão computacional em escala (edge + nuvem).
  • Garantir que as soluções sejam performáticas, seguras, observáveis e fáceis de manter, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia e AWS.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com o time de Machine Learning/Computer Vision, ajudando a levar modelos de IA para produção em ambientes reais.
  • Usar IA para aumentar sua produtividade (por exemplo, para gerar código, testes, documentação, debugging assistido, etc.).
  • Transmitir conhecimento para o time de forma simples, por meio de tutoriais, mini-guias, exemplos de código e pequenos vídeos ou gravações de tela (não precisa ser especialista em vídeo — o que importa é a disposição e o espírito de time).
O que você vai fazer no dia a dia
  • Desenvolver e manter serviços back-end (REST/GraphQL) com boas práticas de código, logs e testes básicos.
  • Ajudar a implementar interfaces web (dashboards, telas de configuração, monitoramento) com foco em clareza para o usuário.
  • Apoiar na configuração e evolução de recursos em AWS (ex.: API Gateway/ALB, Lambda/ECS, S3, bancos gerenciados, CloudWatch, etc.).
  • Participar de code reviews, dailies e discussões técnicas, sempre com abertura para aprender e perguntar.
  • Produzir pequenos tutoriais internos quando resolver um problema relevante, para que o conhecimento fique registrado e possa ser reaproveitado.
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Base sólida em matemática, física ou ciências da computação.
  • Pelo menos 1 estágio ou experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de software (back-end, front-end ou full stack).
  • Conhecimentos práticos em:
  • Alguma linguagem de backend (por exemplo: Node.js, Python, Java, Go, etc.).
  • Algum framework front-end moderno (React, Vue, Angular ou similar).
  • Noções de bancos de dados (SQL e/ou NoSQL).
  • Noções de AWS ou outra cloud (com vontade de aprofundar especificamente em AWS).
  • Experiência com Git e fluxos básicos de versionamento (branches, commits, pull requests).
  • Curiosidade, autonomia e vontade de aprender rápido, com abertura para feedback constante.
Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas ajudam bastante)
  • Experiência real (mesmo que em projeto de faculdade, TCC ou estágio) usando AWS.
  • Alguma vivência com CI/CD, pipelines de deploy ou automação de testes.
  • Interesse por visão computacional, IA ou IoT.
  • Experiência em documentação técnica, gravação de tutoriais internos ou monitoria/mentoria de colegas.
Como é trabalhar na Eyna
  • Ambiente ágil: ciclos curtos, foco em colocar solução em produção e aprender com resultado real.
  • Meritocracia: espaço para crescer rápido conforme entrega, responsabilidade e maturidade técnica aumentam.
  • Cultura de rigor técnico com simplicidade: resolver problemas complexos com soluções enxutas, robustas e auditáveis.
  • Time multidisciplinar (engenheiros, físicos, matemáticos, especialistas em processos) de quem você vai aprender todos os dias.
  • Valorização do uso de IA como alavanca de produtividade e da gestão de conhecimento (o que você aprende, você registra e compartilha).
Como se candidatar

Se você é júnior, mas quer crescer rápido, trabalhar perto de problemas reais de indústria e usar AWS + IA no dia a dia, envie seu currículo e, se tiver, GitHub/portfólio com projetos relevantes.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.

Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation

For more information, you may check our website：

Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.

Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)

Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.

Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!

Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.

We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • Profile

  • Role

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included. As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Enfermagem
description:
Descrição da Empresa VITAMIN FAST é a primeira franquia especialista em VITAMINAS INJETÁVEIS, IMPLANTES HORMONAIS E ESTÉTICA INTEGRATIVA.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO – ENFERMEIRO(A) VITAMIN FAST

Cargo: Enfermeiro(a)

Salário: R$ 4.000,00

Benefícios: VT + VR

Modalidade: Presencial

Desejável: Experiência prévia em clínica de injetáveis, estética avançada, soroterapia e atendimento premium/luxo.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Garantir uma experiência impecável, acolhedora e encantadora para cada paciente, conduzindo toda a jornada – desde o primeiro contato por telefone até o pós-venda – assegurando resultados, segurança e fidelização.

Além disso, será responsável por ministrar aulas práticas de injetáveis para novos enfermeiros e apoiar o time no desenvolvimento técnico.

✨ PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

1. Atendimento & Encantamento

· Ligar ativamente para pacientes (follow-up, reativação, pós-venda, confirmação e remarcação).

· Manter os pacientes ativos na clínica, acompanhando sua jornada e garantindo continuidade dos tratamentos.

· Receber com excelência o paciente, oferecendo atendimento humanizado e experiência premium.

· Explicar protocolos, orientar sobre cuidados e conduzir o paciente até o profissional responsável.

2. Assistência de Enfermagem

· Realizar o exame físico inicial:

· Fotografias

· Peso

· Bioimpedância

· Pressão arterial

· Medida de dobras

· Fazer avaliação da soroterapia e orientar sobre os melhores soros conforme objetivo do paciente.

· Realizar infusões de soro com excelência, segurança e técnica impecável.

· Agendar próximas sessões e acompanhar evolução clínica.

· Auxiliar o médico em procedimentos estéticos e hormonais quando necessário.

3. Preparação de Ambientes

· Preparar e organizar salas de procedimentos, sala de soroterapia e consultórios.

· Repor materiais e zelar pela organização e apresentação impecável das salas.

· Manter o ambiente acolhedor, limpo e dentro dos padrões de atendimento de luxo.

4. Procedimentos Técnicos e Normas

· Garantir técnicas adequadas de desinfecção, esterilização e boas práticas de enfermagem.

· Manter registros de enfermagem completos e atualizados no sistema da clínica.

· Realizar atendimentos domiciliares quando solicitado.

· Fazer cotação de materiais em, no mínimo, 3 fornecedores, buscando melhor custo-benefício.

· Controlar estoque, repor insumos e apresentar planilhas ao responsável.

5. Pós-Procedimento & Fidelização

· Ligar após 72 horas do procedimento para acompanhamento conforme script padrão.

· Realizar pós-venda ativo buscando fidelização, encantamento e reativação de pacientes.

· Oferecer fichas de avaliação, termos de consentimento e orientações pós-procedimento.

6. Educação & Desenvolvimento

· Ministrar aulas práticas de injetáveis para novos enfermeiros da equipe.

· Tirar dúvidas técnicas e apoiar o desenvolvimento do time.

· Participar ativamente dos treinamentos, cronogramas de capacitação e manual de operações.

title: Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores
description:
Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores | EQI Investimentos

Você sonha em construir uma carreira sólida no mercado financeiro, transformar a vida das pessoas por meio dos investimentos e ter a chance de ser contratado pela empresa que mais cresce no mercado financeiro?

Aqui na EQI estamos com vagas abertas para o Programa de Formação de Novos Assessores.

  • Ambiente de muito aprendizado, networking e crescimento.

Como participar?

Se você está comprometido com sua evolução profissional e quer começar a trilhar um caminho de sucesso no mercado financeiro, inscreva-se agora !

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Analyst. The Data Analyst will be responsible for analyzing and interpreting complex datasets, creating reports, and delivering actionable insights to support decision-making. Daily responsibilities include data modeling, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data patterns and trends. The role also involves effective communication with team members and stakeholders to present findings and recommendations clearly.

Qualifications

  • Strong Analytical Skills and expertise in Data Analytics
  • Proficiency in Statistics and Data Modeling techniques
  • Excellent Communication skills for presenting data insights
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is a plus
  • Familiarity with programming languages like Python or R is beneficial
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred
  • Ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines in remote settings

title: Analista de Precificação e Rentabilidade
description:
Nosso cliente é uma empresa multinacional do setor agroalimentar, atuando na indústria alimentícia no desenvolvimento de produtos e soluções voltados para profissionais e consumidores, a empresa oferece matérias-primas de alta qualidade, mercadorias para revenda e produtos, que busca um profissional para atuar como coordenador(a) de qualidade.

Em seu dia a dia você irá:

• Analisar preços líquidos, margens de contribuição e rentabilidade por cliente, produto e canal;

• Elaborar e manter modelos de precificação e simulações de aumento de preço;

• Apoiar a área comercial na construção de propostas e revisões de política de descontos;

• Acompanhar a performance dos preços em relação ao mercado e à concorrência;

• Gerar relatórios e dashboards de KPIs de rentabilidade (preço médio, mix, margem, variação de custos);

• Apoiar o processo de planejamento anual e revisões orçamentárias, com foco em margem e rentabilidade;

• Garantir que as políticas de preço estejam alinhadas à estratégia de lucratividade da companhia.

Quer se candidatar, né? Veja abaixo os requisitos essenciais.

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Pricing, Controladoria Comercial ou Planejamento Financeiro;
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Conhecimento de SAP R/3;
  • Inglês avançado

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Refeição no local
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Combustível
  • Convênio com farmácia

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:

Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;

Escolaridade mínima:

  • Ensino médio técnico completo

Qualificação A: antes do embarque:

  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT

title: Infrastructure automation engineer
description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote

The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI/CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable: Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

description:

Fornecer assessoria jurídica estratégica e especializada em temas relacionados ao setor de energia renovável, concessões, Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs) e projetos greenfield em infraestrutura e energia. title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos:

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa o perfil do cliente para fundamentar decisões criativas na venda.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes).
  • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.

Descrição do Cargo:

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente.
  • Analisar o perfil do cliente e apresentar os vinhos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença na sua experiência.
  • Apoiar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes na loja, assim como realizar "follow up" e pós-venda para clientes cadastrados.
  • Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las.
  • Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação.
  • Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising.
  • Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho.
  • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.
  • Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos (técnico ou de extensão) é um forte diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês e/ou espanhol (para atendimento a clientes estrangeiros).
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de dois anos em atendimento ao cliente e vendas(varejo).
  • Desejável: Experiência prévia no setor de vinhos (lojas, empórios, restaurantes).

Remuneração:

automações que substituem processos manuais, mini aplicações, scripts, conectores usando API, páginas HTML simples com backend integrado.

title: Coordenador de operações

title: Senior Gen AI Engineer (Copilot)
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power AutomateSummary

We are seeking a Senior Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate to support and scale our organization’s use of AI-driven productivity tools. This role blends technical expertise in building and optimizing agents with the ability to support and guide non-technical users. The engineer will troubleshoot Copilot issues, review and refine agents, and ensure compliance with data loss prevention (DLP) and governance policies. Beyond day-to-day support, they’ll help strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) through documentation, lifecycle standards, and observability practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support & Troubleshooting: Own Copilot and Power Automate issue resolution, including connectors, permissions, and workflow errors.
  • Agent Review & Optimization: Refine agents for efficiency, scalability, and compliance with governance standards.
  • User Enablement: Guide employees in safely building and optimizing agents, explaining platform limits and data-handling best practices.
  • Architecture Awareness: Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns to improve design quality.
  • Governance & COE: Partner with data, security, and compliance teams on DLP alignment and contribute to Power Platform COE monitoring and lifecycle initiatives.
  • Documentation & Improvement: Create user guides, document patterns, and propose enhancements based on recurring issues.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core ).
  • Ability to design, troubleshoot, and optimize agent workflows and connectors.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP policies, and governance controls.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical details for non-technical users.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of RAG, multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts.
  • Experience with observability, or cost monitoring.
  • Exposure to enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake).
  • Contribution to a Power Platform COE or similar governance effort.

We Offer:

  • 100% remote job.
  • Long term job.
  • Carreer path.

title: Events Specialist (Mandarin/Chinese Speaker)
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Especialista Contábil
description:

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à gestão.
  • Atuar em processos de licitações e tratativas contábeis junto ao setor público.

  • Liderar, orientar e supervisionar a equipe contábil e fiscal, garantindo prazos e qualidade nas entregas.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo.
  • Pós-graduação completa ou em andamento em áreas correlatas.
  • Curso em Reforma Tributária.
  • Excel avançado e boas habilidades em informática.

Experiência Necessária

  • Atuação em contabilidade geral, tributária e societária.
  • Experiência no setor de prestação de serviços (Lucro Presumido e Real).
  • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores.
  • Atendimento a fiscalizações e órgãos reguladores.
  • Implantação e utilização de ERP (preferencialmente Protheus – TOTVS).
  • Suporte em processos de due diligence e compliance.
  • Gestão de equipe e de prazos para obrigações acessórias.

Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Domínio da legislação tributária brasileira (IR, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ISS etc.).
  • Conhecimento avançado em obrigações acessórias (EFD Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DCTF etc.).
  • Familiaridade com processos de licitações e tratativas junto ao setor público.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical.
